results.sql: WITH m_order AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', orders.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS DATE) AS day, SUM(orders.total_cents) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) AS gross_revenue_cents, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) AS revenue_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')) AS refunded_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE orders.status <> 'pending') AS paid_orders FROM orders WHERE orders.placed_at >= CAST('2026-11-01T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND orders.placed_at < CAST('2026-12-01T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', orders.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS DATE)), m_refund AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', refunds.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS DATE) AS day, SUM(refunds.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds WHERE refunds.created_at >= CAST('2026-11-01T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND refunds.created_at < CAST('2026-12-01T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', refunds.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS DATE)) SELECT day, COALESCE(gross_revenue_cents, 0) * 0.01 AS gross_revenue, (COALESCE(gross_revenue_cents, 0) * 0.01) - (COALESCE(refunded_cents, 0) * 0.01) AS net_revenue, COALESCE(refunded_cents, 0) * 0.01 AS refunded_amount, (CAST(COALESCE(gross_revenue_cents, 0) * 0.01 AS DECIMAL)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(revenue_orders, 0), 0) AS aov, (CAST(COALESCE(refunded_orders, 0) AS DECIMAL)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(paid_orders, 0), 0) AS refund_rate FROM m_order FULL OUTER JOIN m_refund USING (day) ORDER BY day LIMIT 1000

results.sql: WITH m_refund AS (SELECT SUM(refunds.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds WHERE refunds.created_at >= CAST('2026-10-01T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND refunds.created_at < CAST('2026-11-01T00:00:00-04:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) SELECT COALESCE(refunded_cents, 0) * 0.01 AS refunded_amount FROM m_refund LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many distinct customers placed an order this week?
results.answer: 93 distinct customers placed an order this week, defined as customers with at least one order (any status) in the period. As of 2:59 AM EST.
results.sql: WITH m_order AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.customer_id) AS ordering_customers FROM orders WHERE orders.placed_at >= CAST('2026-11-09T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND orders.placed_at < CAST('2026-11-16T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) SELECT COALESCE(ordering_customers, 0) AS active_customers FROM m_order LIMIT 1000

results.question: What's our revenue per order this year?
results.answer: Gross revenue for this year is $3,319,675.39, defined as the sum of order totals for paid, shipped, or delivered orders by order date. Note that cancelled, refunded, and pending orders do not contribute to this metric. As of 2:59 AM EST.
results.sql: WITH m_order AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', orders.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS DATE) AS year, orders.status AS order_status, SUM(orders.total_cents) FILTER(WHERE orders.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')) AS gross_revenue_cents FROM orders WHERE orders.placed_at >= CAST('2026-01-01T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AND orders.placed_at < CAST('2027-01-01T00:00:00-05:00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', orders.placed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS DATE), orders.status) SELECT year, order_status, COALESCE(gross_revenue_cents, 0) * 0.01 AS gross_revenue FROM m_order ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000
